# Murk Stack Apple bindings

Author: Murk Stack (Claude for the owner). Created: 1 November 2026.

The `core:sys/darwin` and `vendor:darwin` bindings as of Odin 33be4cc0e, kept for the stack's macOS backends after
upstream regenerated its Apple bindings under different names. Imports point at `vendor:murk_darwin`; contents are unchanged.
